name: Elveos
source:
Elveos (full name is Elveos Namira) – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change and one of main characters.

Elveos is a young short-faced red yellow-eyes om'verai, 4 chio'tai older than Azaries. Elveos' face is covered by forehead light-purple plates and aries-like grey side horns. Wide "eyebrows" give an impression that Elveos' eyes are always half-closed.

Elveos is a tomboy agressive, rude adventure-minded om'verai. A former school bully, targeting younger om'verai by money collecting.

Elveos is bad at communicating with others, especially with fauna, which often results problems for both her and others. On other hand, more matured Elveos becomes more self-responsible she is regarding taking care about younger om'verai. Elveos enjoys nicknaming others and mispronouncing some words. Always first to fight and get punched.
